hook: A 29-year-old MML Investors Services associate stole $3.8 million from 60 Missouri victims.

sections.voiceover: A 29-year-old MML Investors Services associate stole $3.8 million from 60 Missouri victims.

In October 2026, Trevor Uhls of Lee's Summit, Missouri, pleaded guilty to wire fraud. This former associate of MML Investors Services operated a calculated Ponzi scheme. How did Trevor Uhls trick 60 investors?
But the trap is set, as he now faces 20 years in federal prison.
Prosecutors confirmed Trevor Uhls drained more than $3.8 million from 60 unsuspecting victims. MML Investors Services saw federal authorities secure his guilty plea.
The court confirmed the total loss reached $3.8 million.
